translation: From above the jaw, it descends behind the ear and goes out to Daying (大迎), enters the neck, and disperses below Renying (人迎). When one proceeds and presses the three yang channels, they follow like a file of fish without disorder; this truly cannot be achieved by human strength. Once this accumulation is removed, then above the diaphragm and below the fat there is no obstruction, and disease will not arise by itself.
